newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Neutral API data keeps SIMEX Brent steady.
newsitem.headline: Neutral API data keeps SIMEX Brent steady.

text.p: September Brent futures were untraded at midday on Wednesday, but quoted in line with London's close.
September Brent futures was bid at $19.50 per barrel, without any offers seen.
London Brent futures had closed four cents higher at $19.52, on expectations of a drawdown in API gasoline stocks for the sixth consecutive week.
But the impact of the fall in gasoline stocks was mitigated by a large build in reformulated gasoline stocks.
API statistics showed a minimal rise for crude stocks.
Brokers In Singapore assessed the API statistics as neutral to bearish.
But they said that in the absence of headline news, the market could still to see higher prices over the week, after breaching technical levels.
On NYMEX, September crudes last traded at $20.85, after New York rose six cents to $20.81.
